name: Fruit
description: Guidelines for traveling with fruit in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Fresh whole fruits are allowed through security. Note that agricultural restrictions apply for international flights, and fresh fruit must be declared at customs.

checkedBag.reason: Fresh fruit is allowed in checked baggage, subject to agricultural import rules at your destination.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring fruit on a plane?

travelTips: Fresh whole fruits are allowed through security. Note that agricultural restrictions apply for international flights, and fresh fruit must be declared at customs.

faq.question: Is fruit allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Fruit is allowed in carry-on luggage. Fresh whole fruits are allowed through security. Note that agricultural restrictions apply for international flights, and fresh fruit must be declared at customs.

faq.question: Can you pack fruit in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Fruit is allowed in checked bags. Fresh fruit is allowed in checked baggage, subject to agricultural import rules at your destination.
